title: Will a Fat Tax Work?
authors: Romana Khan; Kanishka Misra; Vishal Kamlaprasad Singh
eligible_reason: Cross-sectional store-level comparison of milk price structures (flat vs. fat-decreasing pricing set at chain/region level) plus a BLP random-coefficients demand model and tax counterfactuals. No treatment timing, no panel DiD.
design_notes: File1.csv is one row per store (1,708 stores) with price-premium bins (dneg, d00..dg20) and demographics for Sections 2.2-3 regressions (no code shipped for these). MainCode.R/BLPfunctions_1.R estimate a BLP model (optim GMM objective, lm(meanutil ~ X2 - 1), lm(delta ~ price + mc price)) on IRI store-month data for Section 4, and simulate fat-tax/rebate counterfactuals.
data_files_note: File1.csv (store-level cross-section, Sections 2.2-3) shipped; fulldata.csv for the structural model (IRI academic data) is not shipped.
data_provenance_note: Store-level aggregates shipped for the descriptive sections; IRI panel for Section 4 must be obtained from IRI.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally; abstract, README and code show a cross-sectional quasi-experiment and structural model. Out of scope.
